infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SMARTOWN requires camera access to capture field inspection photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SMARTOWN requires your GPS location to geo-tag field survey photos and display your position on GIS maps.
